WITH order_execution_join AS (
  SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as count
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertune,
    count,
    SUM(count) OVER () as total_count
  FROM order_execution_join
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertune,
    count,
    count::FLOAT / total_count as share,
    AVG(count::FLOAT / total_count) OVER () as overall_avg_share
  FROM totals
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT count, share, overall_avg_share
  FROM shares
  WHERE share > overall_avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(count) as sum_counts,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - overall_avg_share) as avg_excess
FROM filtered
